How it's made

Cut by hand.
Finished with patience.

Made to your measurements

Send your chest, shoulder and length measurements when you message us. We cut to size before a stitch is sewn.

Embroidery sourced locally

Threadwork is done by hand or on flat-bed machines depending on the pattern, using fabric from trusted West African mills.

Packed and shipped with care

Every garment is steamed, folded on acid-free tissue and boxed before it leaves our workshop.
